name: director-workbench
description: Agent-native MCP control for Director 3D scenes, Canvas graphs, and Video Editor timelines.

interface.shortDescription: Build 3D scenes, Canvas graphs, and edit timelines with an agent.
interface.longDescription: Lets coding agents discover, observe, author, animate, frame, audit, preview, deliver, correct, and undo live 3D Stage, Canvas, and Video Editor changes through one exact-target, revision-guarded, idempotent MCP workflow.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current 3D scene, fix its most important issue, and visually verify delivery.
Build a complete scene with characters, cameras, and animation using atomic guarded authoring.
Audit the active camera, deliver its clean evidence package, and improve the framing.
Arrange the Canvas or Video Editor and verify the result with a fingerprint-bound preview.
